targets.evidence_quote: The goal of the present study was to provide a conceptual replication of the ARCL findings reported by Schmitt and colleagues (2017).
targets.outcome_quote: In sum, the results of the present conceptual replication were mixed. We replicated the results of the EF measurement model and longitudinal stability estimates of EF and literacy across two independent samples. However, we could not replicate the cross-lagged pattern of findings reported in the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall mixed verdict covers both independent samples and takes priority over individual contrasts.
